name: Silicon dioxide (alpha-quartz)

lattice.source: L. Levien, C. T. Prewitt, D. J. Weidner, Am. Mineral. 65 (1980) 920

terminations.description: Ideal bulk truncation with no reconstruction applied.

band_gap.source: T. H. DiStefano and D. E. Eastman, Solid State Commun. 9 (1971) 2259

dielectric_constant.conditions: static (low frequency), room temperature, perpendicular to c; 4.64 parallel to c. Amorphous thermal SiO2 is about 3.9 and is a different material.
dielectric_constant.source: J. Fontanella, C. Andeen and D. Schuele, J. Appl. Phys. 45 (1974) 2852

melting_point.conditions: melting of silica as beta-cristobalite. Alpha-quartz does not melt as such: it converts to beta-quartz at 846 K and to other silica phases before melting.

bond_length.conditions: mean Si-O; the two distinct bonds are 1.6039 and 1.6132 A
bond_length.source: L. Levien, C. T. Prewitt, D. J. Weidner, Am. Mineral. 65 (1980) 920

alpha_beta_transition.conditions: alpha-quartz to beta-quartz at ambient pressure

references: J. Fontanella, C. Andeen and D. Schuele, J. Appl. Phys. 45 (1974) 2852
L. Levien, C. T. Prewitt, D. J. Weidner, Am. Mineral. 65 (1980) 920
T. H. DiStefano and D. E. Eastman, Solid State Commun. 9 (1971) 2259
B. W. H. van Beest, G. J. Kramer and R. A. van Santen, Phys. Rev. Lett. 64 (1990) 1955
provenance_note: Basis expanded from the Wyckoff parameters of L. Levien, C. T. Prewitt and D. J. Weidner, Am. Mineral. 65 (1980) 920, in the P3_2 21 setting with Si on 3a at x = 0.4697, z = 2/3 and O on 6c at (0.4135, 0.2669, 0.7858). The generated cell reproduces the published Si-O distances of 1.604 and 1.613 A and the O-O distances of 2.61-2.64 A, which tests/validation checks on every run. Thermal gate oxide is amorphous; an amorphous SiO2 model is on the roadmap and is not provided in v0.1.
